threads.body:
@copilot Fix the Spring Rabbit latest-dependency test failure in this PR. Update this PR directly rather than creating another PR. Preserve the dependency updates, including Spring AMQP 4.1.2, and keep the fix scoped to the affected test expectations.

The failed job https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/actions/runs/40062685984/job/120786997558 fails :instrumentation:spring:spring-rabbit-1.1:javaagent:test with "Expected span to have name <nack> but was <reject>". In instrumentation/spring/spring-rabbit-1.1/javaagent/src/test/java/io/opentelemetry/javaagent/instrumentation/spring/rabbit/v1_1/SpringRabbitMqTest.java, the affected cases are testProducerBatchWithMessageListener with fail=true for both simple and direct containers, and testErrorHandlerContextPropagation for both containers.

Spring AMQP 4.1.2 intentionally switches these plain MessageListener error paths from basicNack to basicReject. See spring-projects/spring-amqp commit https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-amqp/commit/35bcdbd37d38855630cf9a2196ca59d830cdd2cd. Individual rejection lets RabbitMQ count failed deliveries toward quorum-queue delivery limits. A producer-created batch still represents one delivery tag. The existing RabbitMQ instrumentation already correctly emits reject spans.

Adjust these tests to expect reject for the latest-dependency error paths while preserving nack for baseline dependencies and ack for successful processing. Follow the existing testLatestDeps() convention and reuse verifySettleSpan so both the span name and messaging.operation.name remain strictly checked. Keep short conditional expectations local to the assertions; avoid a new abstraction solely to compute expected values. Do not rename reject spans to nack, weaken assertions to accept either value indiscriminately, revert dependency pins, or change production instrumentation.

Run the narrow module formatter and relevant SpringRabbitMqTest coverage with both baseline and latest dependencies, including both container variants and the producer-batch success and failure cases. Report any execution limitations rather than claiming an unrun test passed.

replies.body: Updated in c4371ae8. Latest-deps failures now expect `reject` via `verifySettleSpan`; baseline remains `nack`, and producer-batch success remains `ack`. The formatter and filtered baseline tests passed. I could not run latest-deps tests locally because Gradle requires JDK 27 for project configuration and Foojay access is unavailable.
